tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise}[Suppose G is a Lie group and M is a homogeneous G-space that admits at least one g-invariant metric] 1. ch3:3.19Show that for each $p \in M$, the map $g \mapsto g_p$ gives a bijection between $G$-invariant metrics on $M$ and $I_p(G_p)$-invariant inner products on $T_p M$. \end{exercise}
